feed.title: Jianhao Wang | 王健豪
feed.subtitle: I am a B.S. student in the ACM Honors Class at Shanghai Jiao Tong University, conducting research on GPU systems optimization at EPCC, advised by Weihao Cui, Han Zhao, and Prof. Quan Chen. My research interests lie in GPU systems and GPU kernel optimization, with a particular focus on GPU NUMA characteristics and hardware-aware optimization methodologies.
